images.name: Transmutation
images.prompt: Create an original druidic magic-path icon matching the painted Oblivion-style bronze frame of the reference. Replace its central glyph with: one antique alchemist's retort containing a jade fluid curl that flows into an amber faceted crystal. A simple, unified emblem of substances changing. Keep the emblem bold and readable at small icon size, with no lettering. Isolated emblem on transparent background.
